description: A pair of fixed foot-contact positions on the authored base. Stance 2 defines foot placement only and uses the locked male elf coin placement as its template.
rules: Stance 2 concerns only the two points where the feet contact the authored base.
Stance 2 does not define or constrain torso angle, knee bend, hand position, gesture, expression, clothing, silhouette, or overall body pose.
The locked male elf footing is the stance-2 placement template.
The locked female elf reaches the same template with a 4 px rightward placement correction relative to transparent-crop centering.
Future placement must use foot-contact anchors rather than transparent image bounds.
